definitions.gloss: victory podium; medal podium; awards platform
definitions.explanation: The raised platform where winners of a competition stand to receive their medals or prizes. Has three levels for first, second, and third place.

examples.japanese: {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ちたい→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I want to stand at the top of the podium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: She stood on the podium three times in a row.

notes:
{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい} is the victory podium where top finishers stand to receive medals or prizes. Composed of ⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧ (commendation) + {台|だい} (platform).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the podium
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to get on the podium (= finish in top 3)
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss the podium (= finish 4th or lower)
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: the top of the podium (= 1st place)

USAGE:
In sports contexts, "{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧" is idiomatically used to mean finishing in the top three, not just literally stepping onto the podium.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧: commendation, award ceremony
- ⟦{表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}→表彰式：20175_hyoushoushiki⟧: award ceremony
- ⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧: medal
